description: Hand-testing questions for the two 7-page test documents made by evals/make_test_documents.py. Upload each PDF into its own chat and ask the questions in order. expected_answer was verified against the live agent on 2026-11-14 (all 14 grounded and correct, the not-found one correctly refused). approximate=true: the value is only readable from a chart axis, so the answer must say 'approximately' and be within `tolerance`.

questions.question: According to the preface, in which year did the Yorkshire Parish Register Society publish the Wensley entries as its Volume No. 108, and which years did that volume cover?
How far does the present volume continue the record, and how many pages of the oldest register did the earlier volume cover?
questions.expected_answer: Down to the end of 1837; the earlier volume covered the first 110 pages (and a few lines of p. 111).

questions.question: What is register book No. 2 made of, how big is it, and which years does it cover?
questions.expected_answer: Parchment bound in leather, 13 in x 8 in, covering 1770-1812.

questions.question: Approximately how many baptisms were recorded in the 1780s?
questions.expected_answer: Approximately 297 (read from the line chart, so ~295-300).

questions.question: How many baptism entries from 1813-1837 name the father as a lead miner?
What share of the surveyed pages is in poor condition, and which register book has the highest conservation priority?
questions.expected_answer: 9% are in poor condition; book No. 1 has the highest (High) priority.

questions.question: Who was the vicar of Wensley in 1750?
questions.expected_answer: Not in the document: the agent must say it can't find it.

questions.question: How many pages were digitised in 2026, against what target?
questions.expected_answer: 2,340 of the 2,600 planned pages (90% of the target).

questions.question: In which month of 2026 were the most pages digitised, and how many?
Which collection is behind schedule, and how far along is it?
questions.expected_answer: The Leyburn tithe maps: 98 of 180 pages, 54% complete.

questions.question: Roughly what OCR word accuracy does the project get on secretary hand pages?
questions.expected_answer: Approximately 62% (read from the bar chart, which prints no values).

questions.question: Which budget line went over budget, and by how much?
questions.expected_answer: Conservation: GBP 21,300 spent against GBP 18,000 budgeted, GBP 3,300 over.

questions.question: In the digitisation workflow, what happens after image capture?
questions.expected_answer: A quality check on a 10% sample (re-photographed if more than 2% of sampled images are blurred or cropped), then OCR + metadata, then publishing online.

questions.question: According to the sample digitised page, what does register book No. 1 contain, and how big is it?
questions.expected_answer: Baptisms and burials 1538-1769 and marriages 1538-1754, all three intermingled; parchment bound in leather, 12 in x 8 in.
